title: Zodiac Festival
text: "Do you believe in fate? Your path is foretold by the stars, Player." Festival title In order to get the title from the event player must buy a Constellation Jar from Merit Badge shop with Merit Badge × 15. The Constellation Jar will give out randomly one of the twelve titles to the player. The title will stay: it can't be changed to another or player can't acquire more titles. Compatibility of the Constellations Only certain constellations are compatible together and players can do the sapling quest only with matching constellation. Below is the list of the compatible constellations. "Do you believe in fate? Your path is foretold by the stars, Player."

Festival title

In order to get the title from the event player must buy a Constellation Jar from Merit Badge shop with Merit Badge × 15. The Constellation Jar will give out randomly one of the twelve titles to the player. The title will stay: it can't be changed to another or player can't acquire more titles.

Compatibility of the Constellations

Only certain constellations are compatible together and players can do the sapling quest only with matching constellation. Below is the list of the compatible constellations.

Quests

[Wheel of Destiny]

Collect Zodiac Leaf 0/15

Other quests give the leaves to complete this one.

Zodiac Leaf



[The Zodiac Festival]

Quani appears at 1p.m., 7p.m., and 12a.m. UTC.

Talk to NPC that appears only on certain times of the day.


[The Wish Cairn]

Touch the stonepiles next to the sheep ranch.


[Astral Aves]

Quest gives an orb item that must be used on the owls to gather their feathers. Owls will spawn between 10p.m. and 8a.m. gametime.


[Laying on the Charms]

Collect 3/3 wool from the sheeps next to the festival area.


[The Shoddy Shepard]

Deliver 100 fabric to the little boy.


Need title on to do

[Tree of Fate: CONSTELLATION NAME] In this quest player needs to find their compatible constellation player. After that both plant their saplings and use the other players sapling to make it flourish. After that player must collect Zodiac Leafs from their own sapling.

Constellation mark

After getting the title, player can touch the pink orb in the middle of the festival area and get their constellations mark above their head.

The constellation mark stay above the head only if the player has the title equipped. Once the title is changed to something else the mark disappears. The Kismet Star Shard item that is one of the rewards in the event can be placed at players house. If touched the item gives the constellation mark for the player if they have title equipped.
